about: Account words (plans/accounts.md 3.1, 3.2, 4.1 to 4.3, 5, D13), shared by the web, Android and Apple apps; each platform's reader test checks every key (phase 2). Announcements (SyncReport.announcements) take one key each: kind device is announceDevice, or announceDeviceUnnamed when name is null; passkey is announcePasskey; kit is announceKit; removed is announceLeft when by equals member (announceLeftUnnamed without a name), else announceRemovedPasskey when passkey, else announceRemovedKit when kit, else announceRemoved (announceRemovedUnnamed without a name); dropped is announceDropped. {name} is the announcement's name. {device} is the name of the member by, from syncDevices: announceUnnamedDevice when that member has no name, announceGoneDevice when it is no longer a member. announcePasskey carries announceNotYou. Kinds device, passkey, kit and dropped are security notices: every profile but a kids profile shows them, and only the owner profile shows announceOk on them (the core answers notOwner to another profile's acknowledgement); removed shows OK on every profile. accountGoneActions' Remove from this device shows on the owner profile only (D13). passkeyLabel is the label savePasskey writes into the roster, the same on every platform: {device} is the saving device's own name, and no date (Last used carries it). {provider} is providerName's entry for apple, google or facebook, else the id the sync server gives another OpenID provider, as it is. {providerAccount} is providerAccount's entry for apple, google or facebook, else providerAccountOther. {date} is the medium date in the device's locale. removeLibraryDebrid is the checkbox under removeLibraryAsk, ticked by default (D13); the core answers debridConnected while one is left. An actions list is the buttons in order, the first the primary. The default path never shows the words Kit (alone), PRF, roster, ticket or sync server. Email sign-in (plans/accounts-email.md): continueWithEmail is its own row under the provider buttons, never continueWith, and email is never a provider button; codeSentTo's {email} is the address as typed, kept in memory only; codeResendIn's {seconds} counts down from 60 after each mail; codeMissing shows at normal weight on the code stage always; the deletion card uses deletionScheduledByEmail and deletionCancelUnlinkEmail when provider is email.
